result.summary: This PR migrates generatetoaddress's parameter extraction from the older request.params[] style to the self.Arg<> API already used by its sibling RPC generatetodescriptor. As a side effect, passing a negative maxtries now raises a JSON-range error instead of silently wrapping to UINT64_MAX. A functional test covering the new rejection behavior is added.
result.problem: generatetoaddress and generatetodescriptor had diverged in how they parse parameters since one was migrated to self.Arg<> and the other was not, per maflcko: 'They diverged since I changed only one of them... I just didn't get around to it yet.' This is a minor internal inconsistency rather than a bug affecting real users.

result.card: This PR migrates generatetoaddress's parameter parsing to the self.Arg<> API already used by generatetodescriptor, for internal consistency, and as a side effect makes negative maxtries values error out instead of silently wrapping to UINT64_MAX. The problem it addresses is minor: an inconsistency introduced when only one of two sibling RPCs was migrated previously, per maintainer maflcko ('I just didn't get around to it yet'). Two reviewers (maflcko, GerardoTaboada) found the change reasonable and harmless, though GerardoTaboada's suggestion to add a release-notes line was never addressed. A later comment from maintainer dergoegge questions whether the PR, which shows signs of LLM assistance, is something the author genuinely wants to pursue, and this has gone unanswered. The author has been silent since 2026-03-30 (170+ days), making the PR Stale. No dependencies; this is a small, low-priority RPC consistency fix with no known real-world impact.
